summary: Magic Empire Global Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 2,678,572 units to certain institutional investors at $1.12 per unit, each unit comprising one Class A ordinary share and one warrant. Warrants carry a $1.12 exercise price, one-year term, and a zero exercise price option allowing nine shares per warrant, with up to 24,107,148 Class A shares issuable. Chaince Securities acts as exclusive placement agent on a reasonable best-efforts basis. Class A shares trade on Nasdaq under MEGL; dual-class structure gives Class B 100 votes per share. This is a routine capital-raising takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and warrant overhang.
